name: Spatial-preserving Dual-axis Auxiliary Supervision
status: complete (5/5 folds x 300 epochs; formal evaluation and auxiliary-head analysis done)

relationship_to_M1.role: minimal controlled follow-up ablating M1's GAP pooling
unchanged: main segmentation network, encoder, decoder, segmentation head
data, folds, plans, 300 epochs, seed/initialisation mode
inference contract: network(x) returns ONLY segmentation logits

dataset.splits: E0 original five-fold split (local/nnunet_preprocessed/.../splits_final.json), not regenerated
dataset.ground_truth: frozen E0 label_gold + TAR manual lines (fixed_gt_v1.csv); label_infer never used

network_architecture.backbone: E0 PlainConvUNet unchanged (verified bit-identical to a same-seed M1/E0 build; 396 backbone tensors)
network_architecture.inference_path: network(x) returns ONLY the original segmentation logits (7-ch, deep supervision)

aux_heads.input_feature: final decoder stage feature (same tensor feeding seg_layers[-1])

loss.segmentation: E0 inherited (CompoundLoss: Dice + CE, with deep supervision) - unchanged
loss.auxiliary: L_aux = (L_card + L_ref) / 2, each averaged over its own valid samples
loss.missing_label_handling: missing/NaN axis labels only mask the corresponding aux loss; case kept in segmentation training

training.init: scratch from epoch 0 (no mid-trimester data, no E2/E3/M1 weights)
training.optimizer: inherited E0 default (SGD, momentum 0.99, nesterov, weight_decay 3e-5)
training.learning_rate: inherited E0 default (0.01, PolyLR over 300 epochs)

internal_validation.protocol: per-fold OOF, each case predicted by the fold model that did not train on it

inference.note: TTA disabled to keep internal and external protocols identical to E0/E2/E3/M1

geometry_postprocessing.card_axis: OBB long axis of largest connected component of id4 and id5, weighted by area*max(aspect-1,0.05), double-angle weighted mean
geometry_postprocessing.full_angle: acute angle between card_axis and ref_axis
geometry_postprocessing.resampling: none; no pixel-level mapping between TAR and segmentation images

paired_bootstrap_vs_baselines.method: paired bootstrap 10000 resamples, seed 42; delta = M1.1 - baseline
paired_bootstrap_vs_baselines.summary: No Full Angle comparison is statistically significant; every 95% CI includes 0.

aux_head_independent_accuracy.summary: Aux heads encode genuine per-case angle info (not constant); Card stronger than Ref.

aux_head_vs_mask_derived.summary: Mask-derived geometry is significantly better than the aux head on every axis/cohort; aux has a lower tail on some Po cases (exploratory).

failures.note: E3 and M1 each had 1 internal full-angle-unavailable case; M1.1 loses none

verdict.statistical_fact: M1.1 is statistically indistinguishable from E0/E2/E3/M1 on Full Angle MAE/P95 and Card/Ref axis error, internal OOF and external; segmentation on par.
verdict.mechanistic_inference: 4x4 spatial pooling fixed M1's GAP collapse (aux loss 0.005 << constant floor ~0.62-0.91, non-constant predictions), confirming the mechanism, but the auxiliary objective is not wired tightly enough to the segmentation/geometry path to move the clinical endpoint.
verdict.met_expectations: Yes as a mechanism check (aux collapse fixed); No as a clinical measurement improvement.
